text:
Anya P: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we shrink the scaler API surface so the allocator owns eviction + placement decisions. Scaler should report desired headroom and pool health only. Thoughts? cc @Samir @Jordan T
Samir: I like separating concerns but worry about the latency/decision-coupling. If allocator handles eviction, we need a clear async contract and failure modes.
Jordan T: Agree. Maybe define a tiny sync surface for emergency eviction requests and an async desired_capacity stream. Avoid allocator polling scaler every few secs.
Liam Chen: Current scaler payload looks like {desired: X, available: Y, prewarm: Z}. My vote: keep it minimal but add a confidence score. Example payload: ```json
{"desired_gpus": 12, "free_gpus": 3, "confidence": 0.78}
```
Samir: Confidence is useful but creates a policy question: who interprets low confidence? Allocator or the policy layer? We should avoid implicit semantics leaking into allocator code.
Anya P: Proposal: scaler returns {desired, free, confidence, shrinkable, eviction_cost_estimate}. shrinkable is a boolean per pool; eviction_cost_estimate is a coarse numeric (e.g., estimated tokens/sec impact) so allocator can rank candidates. If shrinkable==false allocator must not evict without escalation.
Jordan T: +1 on shrinkable. On eviction_cost_estimate: let's normalize by SLA tier. A small tenant with premium SLA should never be evicted even if cost_estimate low. We need (tenant_tier) in the ranking inputs.
Maya: Also we should add burst_credits metadata to avoid thrashing prewarms: {burst_credits: int, last_burst_ts: iso}. Helps decide whether to prewarm vs scale.
EngOps Bot: Deploy: gating/rfcs/scaler-surface v0.2 pushed to staging — https://ci.company/internal/1234 :gear:
Liam Chen: Implementation note: keep backwards compatibility — shim the old fields for 2 weeks and emit deprecation logs. We can gate rollout behind a feature flag.
Samir: Operational requirement: scaler must respond within 300ms for allocation decision paths, otherwise allocator falls back to conservative capacity (double headroom) and emits an alert. Need SLO on that.
Jordan T: For the API shape, propose: ```json
{"pool_id":"p-xyz","desired_gpus":10,"free_gpus":2,"confidence":0.85,"shrinkable":true,"eviction_cost_estimate":0.12,"burst_credits":5,"tenant_tier":"standard"}
```
Anya P: Action items: 1) I'll draft RFC update with the new fields + example payloads 2) Liam to add shim and feature flag in allocator 3) Samir to write SLO for scaler latency + alerting 4) Jordan/Maya to model eviction ranking with tenant_tier and burst_credits 5) schedule canary in staging. I'll start the draft now and ping people for pairing. :handshake:
